title: Add comprehensive GitHub workflows and automation infrastructure
body:
Implements complete CI/CD automation including security scanning, dependency management, and project maintenance workflows.

## New Workflows

**Security & Quality**
- CodeQL analysis for vulnerability detection (push/PR/weekly)
- Gitleaks secret scanning to prevent credential leaks
- Bundle size tracking with automatic PR comments

**Automation**
- Dependabot with smart auto-merge (patch/minor) and grouped updates
- Auto-labeling PRs via 112 file-pattern rules
- Stale issue/PR management (60d/45d thresholds)
- Automatic changelog generation from conventional commits

## Improvements

**CI Pipeline**
- Added pnpm store caching across all jobs (test/lint/build)
- Multi-version testing matrix (Node 18.x, 20.x)
- Codecov integration with proper token handling

**Developer Experience**
- Issue templates (bug/feature) with structured fields
- PR template with comprehensive checklist
- Workflow documentation (`.github/WORKFLOWS.md`)
- Status badges in README

## Configuration

```yaml
# dependabot.yml - Grouped updates
groups:
  patch-updates:
    patterns: ["*"]
    update-types: ["patch"]
  react:
    patterns: ["react*", "@types/react*"]
```

```yaml
# labeler.yml - Pattern-based labeling
'package: core':
  - changed-files:
    - any-glob-to-any-file: 'packages/core/**/*'
```

All workflows follow least-privilege permissions, use commit-pinned actions where security-critical, and include proper error handling.
